run_query_tts: run the query function to send text to the fal-ai Dia-1.6B text-to-speech API and return audio
test_query_function: test the query function with a sample text payload and verify it returns audio and sampling rate
review_query_function: review the query function that posts JSON payloads to the HuggingFace fal-ai router
summarize_query_function: summarize the query function that sends text-to-speech requests to the fal-ai API
create_tts_request: create a text-to-speech request by calling query with a text payload and IPython Audio playback
